verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll documents running payroll with a review-and-approve step before paychecks are sent, including compensation changes (docs-9). It also documents timesheet approval that syncs into QuickBooks (docs-10), Payroll AI that collects time data and flags inconsistencies (docs-1), and submission deadlines for same-day or next-day pay (docs-5, docs-6). missing for 10: explicit documentation of a totals preview screen, explicit confirmation that hours review, earnings review, preview and submit happen in a single flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the run-payroll workflow.
